key: D minor → D major at Kok-Aral
direction: Fresh telemetry/electronics/skin/metal score with wet glass and bowed vibraphone reserved for northern water. Hard stop loudest, dam second, map tear third. Both silences air only; fresh rewind-like sweeps, no original soundtrack reuse.

sections.intent: Orbit drone and FM lock/map pings
Dive subdivisions, riser and low percussion crescendo
Suck-out, D-minor map tear and wind-only aftermath
Accelerating dated rings, descending roots and skins/metal
Loudest hard stop, low aftermath and port lock
Dry Muynak horn, sand and measured range ratchet
Water J-cut, northern whip and dam suck-out
Second-largest slam, D-major brass and returning water/glass
D-major climb, glass and telemetry together, label pin
Low ending, lock echo and final pass
